Functions under their former names

Source: R/deprecated.R
cd2030-deprecated.Rd

The functions that take one indicator out of a computed table, ready to plot, were named filter_*(). They are select_*() now (they choose an indicator and reshape; they do not filter rows as dplyr::filter() does). The former names still work and say once per session what to call instead; they will be removed in a later version.

Usage

filter_adjustment_value(...)

filter_coverage(...)

filter_inequality(...)

filter_mapping_data(...)

filter_mortality_summary(...)

filter_service_utilization(...)

Arguments

...

Passed to the function under its present name.

Value

What the function under its present name returns.

Details

Former nameNow
filter_adjustment_value()select_adjustment_value()
filter_coverage()select_coverage()
filter_inequality()select_inequality()
filter_mapping_data()select_mapping_data()
filter_mortality_summary()select_mortality_summary()
filter_service_utilization()select_service_utilization()
